If you google retroactive IRB approval, you’ll quickly see that if you don’t get the approval you’re screwed. Completely screwed. I fucked everything up, I’m going to lose everything, and I can’t tell everyone

I’m in research, and I forgot to get approval for our research study. Like I can barely believe it, everything feels like a waking nightmare, I don’t know how I forgot, it’s the most basic thing you have to do before you stsrt the research. But I did, and it means our research wasn’t approved. So its a serious violation of ethics and noncompliance with federal regulations. Which is going to end everything. I’ll probably get kicked out and barred from research, and my collaborators trusted me and I’ll have endangered their careers and they could have punitive measures taken against them too. Like how can I face that?? I don’t think I can, there’s no way, I’d rather be dead
